CARRIE — JOB #411 — QUESTIONS TO ANSWER ON SITE
Target: approximately $10,000. Carrie reports 54 sqft; verify it. Panel shower and vinyl are provisional options, not approved products. This worksheet is not a quote. Zero values, blanks, and existing presets need review before pricing.

BUDGET AND PRIORITIES
[ ] Does $10,000 include fixtures, flooring, tax, delivery, disposal, and HWC installation?
[ ] What must be replaced now? What can stay or wait?
[ ] Are niches, glass/shower door, a new room door, and upgraded fixtures still wanted from the original calculator selections?

MEASUREMENTS AND PRODUCT FIT
[ ] What are the actual room length, width, ceiling height, shower opening/base dimensions, vanity space, and access widths?
[ ] Where are the shower drain and valve? Can they stay in place?
[ ] Which off-the-shelf shower kit fits? Does its price include base, walls, drain, valve/trim, enclosure, adhesive, and sealant?
[ ] Which vanity/top/sink/faucet, toilet, light, and wall-mounted mirror does Carrie want? Record exact models and photos.
[ ] Is the floor vinyl/LVP, Marmoleum, or staying as is? What area will actually be replaced?

SITE CONDITION AND WORK
[ ] What must be demolished, removed, hauled away, and protected?
[ ] Is the subfloor sound and dry? What preparation, leveling, rot, or water damage is visible?
[ ] What wall repairs, painting, trim, or transitions are needed? Turn accepted work on in Scope.
[ ] Is lighting a direct replacement or does it need wiring changes? Who performs and prices the electrical work?
[ ] Are plumbing changes, permits, or other trade coordination needed?
[ ] How many hours are needed for shower installation, drain hookup, flooring installation, and floor prep? Enter 0 prep only after checking.

PURCHASES AND FINAL REVIEW
[ ] Who buys each product: Carrie or HWC? Record quote, tax, delivery, availability, and responsibility for incompatible products.
[ ] Replace every blank/0 or preset quote for HWC purchases with an actual cost, including mirror, light, fittings, and consumables. Uncheck HWC supply for Carrie purchases; installation remains included.
[ ] What is the total of Carrie's separate purchases? Add it to HWC's price when comparing with $10,000.
[ ] Are any accepted tasks missing from the assembled estimate? Add priced lines for them.
[ ] What is excluded? How will concealed repairs be priced if found after demolition?
[ ] If the complete scope exceeds $10,000, which priced options can be deferred? Keep realistic hours and current trade rates.
[ ] Mark measurements checked only after measuring. Download the completed draft before leaving.
